name: Saffron
siboNotes: Saffron is well-tolerated in SIBO diets due to typical small serving sizes and FODMAP-free nature.
preparationTips: Soak threads in warm water or broth for 10-15 minutes before adding to dishes
Grind threads with a small amount of salt to release more flavor
Add at the end of cooking to preserve delicate flavor and color
A little goes a long way - start with just a pinch
